goal: Break the monolithic Admin.jsx into modular components and set up new admin routing structure while preserving existing functionality
summary: Phase 1 completed successfully. Created directory structure with 12 admin files (8 pages under src/pages/admin/, 4 shared components under src/components/Admin/). Extracted three major feature blocks from Admin.jsx into standalone pages: AdminChat.jsx (2,992 lines, chat/messaging with Unread/Read/Sent tabs and socket.io real-time), AdminQuotations.jsx (507 lines, farmer lookup + quotation upload + LR dispatch), AdminPayments.jsx (130 lines, payment history with status filters). Built AdminLayout.jsx wrapping AdminSidebar (NavLink navigation) and AdminHeader. Updated App.jsx with nested /admin/* routes while preserving the legacy /admin route for backwards compatibility. Verified original Admin.jsx functions intact and build passes.
stepSummaries:
1. Create directory structure: src/pages/admin/ with sub-pages (Inbox, Quotations, Payments, Tracking) and src/components/Admin/ with shared components (AdminLayout, AdminSidebar, AdminHeader) [verified]
  2. Extract chat/messaging UI into AdminChat.jsx component preserving Unread/Read/Sent tabs and all message handling logic [verified]
  3. Extract quotation upload and payment tracking into AdminQuotations.jsx and AdminPayments.jsx [verified]
  4. Create AdminLayout with sidebar navigation linking to all admin sections and update App.jsx with nested /admin/* routes [verified]
  5. Verify existing admin flows still work: login, view messages, upload quotation, track payment, add LR number [verified]
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
